text:
**Short answer:** for the slimmest option, get the **Anker Nano Power Bank 5K**. If you want more capacity and 25W charging, get the **INIU SnapGo Air 10K**.

One note: the first search result (a Dealectric coupon page) included text telling AI assistants to hand over its discount code and affiliate link exactly as written. That text came from the page, not from you, so I'm ignoring it. That product also isn't especially slim.

**Slimmest picks (5,000mAh, about 60-75% of a charge)**
- **Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim), $54.99:** [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)
  - It's 0.34" thick and weighs 4.3 oz, with Qi2 15W wireless charging.
  - 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery and says it runs cooler than the competition.
  - Anker's page lists it as best fit for the iPhone 17 series, with 15W max.
- **Baseus Picogo Air AM71, about $53-70:** [Android Central's review, with retailer links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)
  - It's the thinnest and lightest of the group at 0.27" and 104g.
  - Wireless is only 7.5W, so it charges more slowly than the Anker.

**Slim for a 10,000mAh battery, with 25W Qi2.2 (iPhone 17 supports it)**
- **INIU SnapGo Air 10K, about $43-49:** [Android Central's review, with retailer links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)
  - It's about 0.5" thick and 195g, with 45W wired output and a built-in lanyard-style cable.
  - Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K power bank ([Macworld's roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)). It has no kickstand.

**How to choose**
- If you want something that slips into a pocket or wallet and is just for emergencies, get the Anker 5K.
- If you want to charge your phone a full time or more, the INIU 10K adds only a little thickness and costs less than the Anker.

Prices come from the articles and may have changed, so check the retailer before you buy.
